data.summary:
Power Platform Developer with 3 years of overall experience, including
2.5 years of hands-on expertise in Copilot and AI-driven automation using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Azure OpenAI. Skilled in Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and Azure integrations for scalable enterprise solutions.

all_skills: Copilot & AI Integration : Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents)
Azure & Cloud Services: Azure Functions (Isolated/In- Process)

responsibilities: Designed, configured, and deployed Copilot and chatbot solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio integrated with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Dynamics 365.
Created conversational flows, prompt libraries, and generative AI plugins to extend Copilot capabilities across departments.
Worked on front-end development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Python.

projects.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Center – Copilot Booking System
projects.description:
Dynamics 365 Customer Center – Copilot Booking System
Developed an AI-powered Copilot using Copilot Studio integrated with Dynamics 365 Customer Center to automate customer bookings. Designed Adaptive Cards for service selection, built a custom connector in Power Automate for backend booking, and automated slot allocation for real-time confirmations.
Technologies Used: Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents), Power Automate,
Dynamics 365 Customer Center, Custom Connectors, Adaptive Cards, Azure

projects.name: Document Processing System (AI Builder):
projects.description:
Document Processing System (AI Builder):
Built an AI-powered solution to extract data from invoices and PDFs using AI Builder. Automated workflows with Power Automate to store data in SharePoint and notify stakeholders, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
Technologies Used: Power Apps, AI Builder, Power Automate, SharePoint.

projects.name: AI-Guided Migration Tool
projects.description:
AI-Guided Migration Tool
Developed an AI-powered migration solution to automate visualization changes, enabling seamless shifting of reports from one visualization framework to another, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort.

projects.name: HR Self-Service Copilot Chatbot (Power Platform)
projects.description:
HR Self-Service Copilot Chatbot (Power Platform)
Developed an AI-powered HR Self-Service Copilot using Copilot Studio integrated with Power Automate and SharePoint, enabling employees to get instant answers to HR-related queries (leave balance, policies, holidays, etc.) and submit common requests through chat.
Technologies Used: Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents) , Power Automate,
SharePoint,Microsoft Teams ,Power Apps .

projects.name: Time and Lieu System
projects.description:
Time and Lieu System
Built a user-friendly system to manage time-in-lieu requests using Power Apps Canvas App. SharePoint served as the backend, and Power Automate handled approvals, reminders, and status updates. Designed with a clean UI for better user experience.
Technologies Used: Power Apps Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint.

projects.name: Compliance Management System:
projects.description:
Compliance Management System:
Created a Compliance Management System using Canvas App to automate document expiration notifications and enhance compliance reporting and decision-making.
Technologies Used: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint, Power BI.
